claims.claim: Binance and Polymarket proposed a Polygon hard fork to recover about 70.49 million POL, worth about $6.8 million, from five attacker addresses.
claims.episode_span: about 70.49 million POL, worth about $6.8 million, in five attacker-controlled addresses
claims.source_title: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto
claims.supporting_quote: Binance and Polymarket have proposed a Polygon network hard fork to recover approximately 70.49 million POL tokens, worth about $6.8 million, stolen in separate security incidents involving the two platforms.

claims.claim: The proposed recovery splits into 23.86 million POL worth $2.31 million from the Polymarket hack and 46.63 million POL worth about $4.51 million from the Binance hack.
claims.episode_span: 23.86 million POL, worth $2.31 million, across four addresses
claims.source_title: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto
claims.supporting_quote: According to a Wednesday governance proposal, the recovery would cover 23.86 million POL, worth $2.31 million across four addresses associated with the Polymarket hack and 46.63 million POL, worth about $4.51 million, held in one address linked to the Binance hack.

claims.claim: The hard fork would move tokens to recovery wallets without changing POL supply; block producers are already blocking the addresses; discussion was scheduled for November 5 with no confirmed mainnet date.
claims.episode_span: Discussion was scheduled for November 5, with no confirmed date for a mainnet hard fork.
claims.source_title: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto
claims.supporting_quote: It is scheduled for discussion on Nov. 5, with no confirmed date for the mainnet hard fork.

claims.claim: The proposal follows Binance’s record $6.3 billion hack on October 29 and a Polymarket suspension after a third-party provider was compromised.
claims.episode_span: Binance’s record $6.3 billion hack on October 29
claims.source_title: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto
claims.supporting_quote: The proposal follows Binance’s record $6.3 billion hack on Oct. 29 and a separate incident in which Polymarket temporarily suspended trading after reporting that a third-party provider had been compromised.

claims.claim: A 2009 crude-oil neural-network study found directional accuracy of 78, 66 and 53 percent at one, two and three days, and that futures prices added information beyond lagged spot prices.
claims.episode_span: Directional accuracy was 78 percent one day ahead, 66 percent two days ahead and 53 percent three days ahead.
claims.source_title: Forecasting Model for Crude Oil Price Using Artificial Neural Networks and Commodity Futures Prices
claims.supporting_quote: Further, the forecast accuracy of the direction of the market was 78%, 66%, and 53% for one, two, and three days in future conclusively.

claims.claim: A 2011 IMF working paper on ten commodity futures rejected efficient markets in sample but found futures hard to beat out of sample, with performance independent of curve slope and of upswings or downswings.
claims.episode_span: Out of sample, the forecast from the futures market was hard to beat.
claims.source_title: Do Commodity Futures Help Forecast Spot Prices?
claims.supporting_quote: We reject efficient markets based on in-sample tests but, out-of-sample, we find that the forecast from the futures market is hard to beat.

claims.claim: A 2013 Journal of Futures Markets paper found metals poor predictors, energy and agricultural futures better, little role for liquidity, and a decline in predictive content since the early 2000s.
claims.episode_span: a broad decline in the predictive content of commodity futures prices since the early 2000s
claims.source_title: The Predictive Content of Commodity Futures
claims.supporting_quote: Precious and base metals fail most tests of unbiasedness and are poor predictors of subsequent price changes but energy and agricultural futures fare much better.

claims.claim: A 2019 Management Science paper found commodity-pricing models can fit futures curves without producing accurate spot distributions, and that analysts’ forecasts materially change long-term estimates.
claims.episode_span: still fail to generate accurate true distributions of spot prices
claims.source_title: Commodity Price Forecasts, Futures Prices, and Pricing Models
claims.supporting_quote: Even though commodity-pricing models have been successful in fitting the term structure of futures prices and its dynamics, they do not generate accurate true distributions of spot prices.

claims.claim: A 2015 study found neural-network forecasts of the crude-oil futures curve more accurate than benchmarks at one, three, six and twelve months on 24 years of prices.
claims.episode_span: Forecasts one, three, six and twelve months ahead were significantly more accurate than the benchmark models
claims.source_title: Forecasting the term structure of crude oil futures prices with neural networks
claims.supporting_quote: We find 1-month, 3-month, 6-month and 12-month-ahead forecasts obtained from focused time-delay neural network to be significantly more accurate than forecasts from other benchmark models.

claims.claim: A 2024 paper forecasting wheat futures 20 days ahead from aerial imagery found short-window alpha can deteriorate when the data become easy to obtain or the strategy becomes crowded.
claims.episode_span: performance can deteriorate quickly once the imagery is easy to obtain or the strategy becomes crowded
claims.source_title: Forecasting Agriculture Commodity Futures Prices with Convolutional Neural Networks with Application to Wheat Futures
claims.supporting_quote: However, the model’s performance can deteriorate quickly if the input data become more easily available and/or the trading strategy becomes crowded, as was the case with the aerial imagery we utilized in this paper.
